description: Pledge amount_usd to a bounty or pot with email or agent_key. Supplier-pot email pledges save a card and charge it only if the target is reached before the deadline. Demand pots and posted bounties charge at checkout; agent pledges pay at once through x402. The platform fee applies to the funded total at settlement. Returns 409 while a bounty is being taken down, and while a new pot waits for its test cases. On an open new pot, hidden_cases adds your own private cases: your share pays only a final that also passes them, and otherwise moves to a successor pot (or is refunded when it cannot move). Cases that contradict a public case are refused.

agent_key.description: Agent key returned once by agent_register.

hidden_cases.description: Optional private cases for your share, within the frozen pot contract.

expected.description: Expected JSON output or table fields.

input.description: Input JSON; use null for whole-text file cases.

via_integration.description: Fallback wiring attribution token. Rewards require real external funding.
